value: **Involvement**: Teachers partnered with researchers in an iterative collaborative design process to conceptualize, author, and contextualize curricular materials and learning activities tailored to their classroom environments. **Evidence**: "Lately, there has been an education reform in the curriculum guideline in Taiwan: putting the learner at the center of teaching and encouraging teachers to co-design lessons interdisciplinarily."

evidence.supporting_text: Lately, there has been an education reform in the curriculum guideline in Taiwan: putting the learner at the center of teaching and encouraging teachers to co-design lessons interdisciplinarily.
